Cat Harness & Leash + Collar Kit

Lightweight Comfort: Cushioned, barely-there feel
Adjustable Fit: Customizes easily for a secure, comfortable wear
Breakaway Safety: Collar releases under pressure
Description

Everything you need for safe, comfortable cat adventures. This complete walking kit includes our escape-resistant Cat Harness & Leash alongside a lightweight Breakaway Cat Collar for everyday wear. Designed specifically for cats, the harness features a comfort-first fit with adjustable straps and soft materials, while the breakaway collar includes a safety buckle designed to release under pressure. Finished with lightweight hardware and playful details, this all-in-one set makes it easy to gear up for both indoor and outdoor routines.

Important: The leash should only be attached to the harness — never to the breakaway collar.

Product Details

Kit Includes
1 Cat Harness
1 Cat Leash
1 Breakaway Cat Collar

Materials
Harness & Leash:
Polyester
Neoprene Padding
Zinc Alloy D-Ring & Leash Clip
Plastic Hardware

Breakaway Collar:
Polyester Webbing
Breakaway Plastic Buckle
Metal Bell
Silicone Slider

Care & Caution

Care
Harness & Leash:
Hand wash cold. Lay flat to dry.

Breakaway Collar:
Spot clean as needed. Air dry fully before use.

Caution
Never attach the leash to the breakaway collar. The leash is designed for use with the harness only.

Inspect regularly and replace immediately if any part becomes damaged or loose.

For pet use only. Not intended for children.

Always supervise your cat during outdoor use.

Shipping & Returns

Shipping
We offer free standard shipping on all domestic orders of $90 and above! Nothing stands between you and your order except 5-9 business days. Need it sooner? We got you. Just select Expedited shipping at checkout for delivery in 2–4 business days.

Returns
Items may be returned or exchanged within 30 days of delivery if they have not been used. Products may be carefully tried on to confirm fit, but items that have been used outdoors, soiled, damaged, or show signs of use beyond try-on are not eligible for return or exchange.

Start your return or exchange through our Online Return Portal.

Orders with Shipping Protection include a prepaid return shipping label. For orders without Shipping Protection, the cost of the return shipping label will be deducted from your refund.

Items discounted 40% or more are final sale and not eligible for returns or exchanges.

Personalization
Personalized items are made to order and cannot be returned or exchanged. Adding personalization can take up to an additional 2 business days to process.
